78AE: No content, controls, or hierarchy visible
Ambiguous state—could be loading or empty
No speaker, timestamp, or transcript information
962B: Floating control bar with playback and recording indicator (clear state)
Left and right panels with transcript organized by speaker (colored badges) and timestamp
